Answer: D
Reason: The imaging series demonstrates a rapid progression from a normal baseline to severe bilateral alveolar consolidations, followed by complete resolution in the follow-up images (Figures 5a and 5b). This pattern of acute lung injury with full radiographic recovery is characteristic of Weil Syndrome (severe leptospirosis) or similar acute infectious pneumonias, distinguishing it from chronic conditions or those with residual fibrosis.
